{{Quote|The planet is called Thule. Thousands of years ago, it was a hidden Sith stronghold. Ulic fought there during the war. That's where the Dark Reaper is buried.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|audio=AnakinDiscussesThule.flac|<ref name="Game" />}}
At the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]]. With the help of former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces disabled the [[Dark Reaper]], a deadly [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], during the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the Dark Reaper was [[Battle of Raxus Prime (Great Sith War)|unleashed]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], and later destroyed on the same planet.<ref name="TNEC" />
